[P2] Forward the step cancellation signal to model requests

This callback discards `StepContext.signal`; `llm.ask` does the same. When a parallel/map batch finishes early, its remaining model requests continue until completion or the invocation deadline. Those steps remain `EXECUTING`, delaying suspension of a subsequent wait and billing time for discarded results. Receive the step context and combine its cancellation signal with the request deadline, preserving the distinction between cancellation and timeout. Cover early completion with an abort-aware fake transport.
